## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.12

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line. Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **EV planning:** open-cycle latch only keeps `available_from=now` on the same calendar day as FertigUm (no midday plan while unplugged overnight)
- **PV forecast:** naive/aware-safe `X-Ratelimit-Retry-At` handling (no crash on 429)
- **Hauskonfigurator:** Temperatur-RC expander annual kWh uses live Standort geo (no 0 kWh/a after expand)
- **Debug-Dump:** UTF-8 BOM-safe `config.json` / run_state read
- **Optimierer-Dienst:** `earnie.log` start separator (pid + version); second Aktualisieren at log bottom

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.12` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`) after you approve **promote**
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
